headline: Profit dips on valuation swing; operations stay resilient
summary_short: Azrieli Group's Q2 FY2026 net income fell to NIS 155M from NIS 320M y/y on a property fair-value swing, while NOI rose to NIS 651M and FFO held near flat at NIS 426M.
summary_long: Q2 FY2026 net income was NIS 155M, down 51.6% y/y from NIS 320M. NOI was NIS 651M, up 0.5% y/y from NIS 648M. FFO (incl. senior housing) was NIS 426M, up 0.2% y/y from NIS 425M. EBITDA was NIS 549M, up 5.6% y/y from NIS 520M. Revenue was NIS 970M, up 2.2% y/y from NIS 949M. EPS was ₪1.44, down 67.7% q/q from ₪4.44 and down 45.6% y/y from ₪2.64.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Company IR page (azrieligroup.com/investor-relations) returned HTTP 403; no direct company-hosted press release or maya.tase.co.il filing URL was located within the search/fetch budget. NOI, FFO, net income, EBITDA, and revenue figures are drawn from wire-service recaps (not independently re-derived) citing the company's own reported NIS figures. The resolver's eps_usd metric carried a unit label of 'ILA' on the current-quarter value versus 'ILS' on both prior values even though the magnitudes (1.4352 / 4.44 / 2.64) are only consistent if all three share the same ILS-per-share basis — treated here as ILS/NIS and flagged as a ledger inconsistency rather than resolved.
